Urinary tract infection in older adults.symptoms: Burning urination, frequency, urgency, sometimes confusion or falls in elderly.

Nausea and vomiting of pregnancy.symptoms: Morning sickness, nausea, vomiting, food aversions, usually first trimester.

Heartburn in pregnancy.symptoms: Burning chest pain after meals, worse when lying down, common in later pregnancy.

Anaemia in pregnancy.symptoms: Fatigue, pallor, shortness of breath, low haemoglobin on blood test.

Constipation in pregnancy.symptoms: Hard infrequent stools due to hormonal slowing of gut and pressure from uterus.

Gestational diabetes monitoring support.symptoms: High blood sugar detected in pregnancy, often no symptoms; screened routinely.

Canine flea infestation.symptoms: Itching, scratching, visible fleas or flea dirt, hair loss, secondary skin infection.

Feline upper respiratory infection.symptoms: Sneezing, nasal discharge, conjunctivitis, reduced appetite in cats.

Canine diarrhoea.symptoms: Loose stools, urgency, sometimes blood or mucus, dehydration risk.

Tick-borne illness prevention (dogs).symptoms: Prevention of tick attachment and related diseases such as babesiosis or ehrlichiosis.

Worm infestation in pets.symptoms: Weight loss, pot belly in puppies, visible worms in stool, dull coat.
